subject: Req: PO line-item ledger + preferred invoice rhythm for Monolith
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@monolithtx.com>, Monolith Procurement <procurement@monolithtx.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Req: PO line-item ledger + preferred invoice rhythm for Monolith

Hi Derek / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. To keep the procurement process moving on your side, a few items we want to confirm up front so we can accept a PO without delays:

1) Line-itemization: You mentioned the PO needs a separate line item per product (hosted API, dedicated reserved seats, and observability add-on) and the ability to include a cost-center tag on each invoice line. We can provide distinct line items; please confirm whether the cost-center must be embedded in the description field or passed as a separate accounting code on the invoice.

2) Invoice cadence: We typically issue a single consolidated monthly invoice. You noted Monolith prefers a quarterly consolidated invoice but can accept monthly provided the PO reflects monthly billing. Would Monolith sign a PO that references a monthly invoice cycle? If not, we can discuss a quarterly billing arrangement but will need to align on minimum commit and proration rules for mid-quarter activations.

3) Net terms & payment routing: Do you require Net 60 vs Net 45? Also confirm the AP remit address and whether ACH or wire is preferred — Monolith can provide an ACH form and we can route invoices to your vendor portal.

Attached is a draft billing spec that maps our SKU line items to typical PO line entries — feel free to share with your procurement/finance folks.

Next steps: if you can send the Monolith PO template (or the PO itself) I’ll loop in our Finance lead Marissa and Ben from Billing to confirm we can meet the exact line-item and ledger requirements.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: redwood-billing-spec-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet mapping SKUs to invoice lines)
From: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@monolithtx.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Monolith Procurement <procurement@monolithtx.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@monolithtx.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Req: PO line-item ledger + preferred invoice rhythm for Monolith

Alex —

Thanks for the quick summary. Attaching our standard PO template and a short note on Monolith AP constraints. Key points:

- PO must contain individual line items (we can accept descriptions for cost-center allocation, but the field 'account_code' must be populated on each line).
- Monolith will only sign for monthly invoices if we receive a consolidated monthly statement grouped by cost center. If you cannot provide a monthly consolidated statement, the PO must indicate quarterly billing and include the quarter start/end and proration rules.
- Preferred terms: Net 60 for vendors onboarding in Q2; finance can consider Net 45 for strategic partners with pre-approved credit.
- Attachments: PO_Template_Monolith.pdf (fillable).

We are open to a compromise: accept monthly invoicing if Redwood includes a machine-readable CSV of line items (account_code, description, amount) with each invoice. Can you produce that CSV automatically from your billing pipeline?

Derek Shaw
Head of Procurement, Monolith Therapeutics
derek.shaw@monolithtx.com
+1 (617) 555-2299

Attachments: Monolith_PO_Template.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Monolith PO template + AP constraints — need billing confirmation

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Monolith's PO template and summary below. They require:
- per-line account_code field (must appear on the invoice lines),
- monthly consolidated invoices grouped by cost center OR quarterly invoices with defined proration,
- machine-readable CSV of line items attached to each invoice if we keep monthly cadence,
- they prefer Net 60 but will consider Net 45 for strategic partners.

Questions for finance:
1) Can Redwood include an account_code field on invoice line items and also emit a CSV (account_code, description, amount, sku) automatically per invoice?
2) If we do quarterly billing for them, how do we handle proration when onboarding mid-quarter (they asked for explicit proration rules)?
3) Does offering Net 45 to Monolith create any internal approval/credit review gating we should surface to sales?

Pls advise — we want to get a PO signed this week.

— Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:06:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Monolith PO template + AP constraints — billing confirmation

Alex / Marissa —

We can accommodate Monolith's ask with the following implementation (low lift, used for other enterprise customers):

- Invoice line items: Our billing system supports free-text description + structured metadata. We can surface an 'account_code' column on the invoice PDF and include the same field in the line-level CSV export. I've attached a sample invoice (proposed-invoice-sample.pdf) showing the 'account_code' column.

- Machine-readable CSV: yes — we will emit a per-invoice CSV (account_code, sku, description, qty, unit_price, line_amount). This can be attached to the PDF invoice and uploaded to your vendor portal. We can enable this automatically for Monolith via a billing flag on the account.

- Billing cadence: Monthly consolidated invoices are the default. If Monolith insists on quarterly billing, we treat quarter as a billing period and perform proration at activation. Proration rules: full-month proration (charge = daily rate * days active in month) aggregated across the quarter, then billed at quarter end. Example included in attached spreadsheet.

- Net terms: Net 45 is available for strategic partners after a quick credit review. For Net 60 (default for Q2 onboardings), we need the signed PO and a copy of W9/ACH details. Approver: Finance Director (Marissa) signs off on Net 45 exceptions.

Action items for Sales:
1) Ask Monolith to populate account_code on each PO line or provide a mapping table we can ingest.
2) If they want monthly invoices with CSV, confirm that CSV schema is acceptable (see attached billing spec).
3) If they request Net 45, route a credit exception request to Marissa and attach PO + vendor registration form.

Ben Carter
Head of Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: proposed-invoice-sample.pdf, redwood-billing-spec-2026.xlsx
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@monolithtx.com>, Monolith Procurement <procurement@monolithtx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Req: PO line-item ledger + preferred invoice rhythm for Monolith

Derek / Elena —

Thanks — appreciate the clear template. Per Ben / Marissa we can:

- Accept the Monolith PO with per-line account_code. If Monolith can populate account_code on the PO (ideal), we will carry that field through to the PDF invoice and to an attached CSV. If Monolith cannot populate it, please provide a mapping file listing your cost centers and corresponding account_codes and we will apply them on our end.

- Continue with consolidated monthly invoices and include the machine-readable CSV per invoice (account_code, sku, description, qty, unit_price, line_amount). If you still prefer quarterly billing, we will need the PO to indicate the quarter and accept our proration approach (full-month prorations aggregated across the quarter).

- Net terms: default Net 60 for Q2 onboardings; Net 45 is approval-based. If Monolith needs Net 45, please return the PO and vendor registration and mark Net 45 in the header; I'll open the credit exception with Marissa today.

If that all sounds good I can send a redlined PO (with the account_code column pre-populated where available) and Ben will flip the billing flag so your vendor portal receives CSV attachments automatically.

Next step: please sign and return the attached PO template or send confirmation on monthly vs quarterly and Net 45 vs Net 60 by EOD tomorrow so we can schedule provisioning for the Dedicated pool.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
